description: The performance budgets of docs/product/blueprint.md, section 6, compared with cs-bench results by scripts/perf-compare.py (which documents the result schema and the metrics). Change a budget only with the blueprint, in a pull request that says why. The Ray-traced tier's indirect light is dynamic and has no time budget.

fields.metric: a metric of the result schema; every metric is a cost, lower is better
fields.limit: the largest value within budget, in SI units: seconds, or bytes with GB = 10^9 bytes
fields.unit: the unit of the metric and the limit: s or bytes
fields.scene: the benchmark scene the budget is measured on: bench/scenes/<scene>, or generated by cs-bench
fields.tier: the column of the blueprint's budget table: standard or raytraced (the cs-bench --tier)
fields.hardware: the reference hardware, as machine or CPU slugs (cs-bench --device-report); any for every machine
fields.size: where present, the render size in pixels the budget holds at; other sizes are not compared with it
fields.enforced_from: the milestone from which exceeding the budget fails; before it, perf-compare.py reports the gap without failing
fields.note: the blueprint's row, and where the milestone comes from
